text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2024: - Monday, January 22 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, February 26 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, March 18 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, April 15 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, May 13 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, June 10 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, July 15 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, September 23 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, October 28 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday, November 25 at 9:30 a.m.
